'''Vyacheslav Fedorovych Klepikov''' ({{langx|uk|В'ячеслав Федорович Клепіков}}; 13 July 1949 – 1 March 2026) was a Ukrainian nuclear physicist.<ref>{{Cite web |title=INSPIRE |url=https://inspirehep.net/authors/1944516 |access-date=2026-03-03 |website=inspirehep.net}}</ref> He was also a professor, doctor of physical and mathematical sciences.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Azarenkov |first=M.O. |last2=Babich |first2=A.V. |last3=Bazaleev |first3=M.I. |last4=Bryukhovetsky |first4=V.V. |last5=Bilous |first5=V.A. |last6=Bulavin |first6=L.A. |last7=Garkusha |first7=I.Ye. |last8=Girka |first8=I.O. |last9=Denisov |first9=V.Y. |last10=Zabulonov |first10=Yu.L. |last11=Karnauhov |first11=I.M. |last12=Kasatkin |first12=Yu.O. |last13=Kyryllin |first13=I.V. |last14=Kovalenko |first14=G.D. |last15=Konovalenko |first15=O.O. |date=2024-09-18 |title=Vyacheslav Fedorovych Klepikov (to his 75th birthday) |url=https://ujp.bitp.kiev.ua/index.php/ujp/article/view/2023445 |journal=Ukrainian Journal of Physics |volume=69 |issue=8 |pages=620 |doi=10.15407/ujpe69.8.620 |issn=2071-0194|url-access=subscription }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-03-03 |title=Новини Харкова - Помер відомий харківський фізик {{!}} Головні новини Харкова сьогодні |url=https://www.sq.com.ua/ukr/novini/02.03.2026/pomer-vidomii-xarkivskii-fizik |access-date=2026-03-03 |website=Status Quo |language=uk}}</ref>

== Education ==
Klepikov graduated from the [[Kharkiv State University]] in 1972 in physics and technology. 

== Career ==
He worked at the [[Kharkiv Institute of Physics and Technology]], now also known as the National Scientific Center. He was an advisor to the director of Technical Center for Electrophysical Processing and later, the Institute of Electrophysics and Radiation Technologies of the NAS of Ukraine until 2021.<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web |date=July 2015 |title=Institute of Electrophysics & Radiation Technologies National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine |url=http://www.iert.kharkov.ua/en/structure.html |access-date=2026-03-03 |website=iert.kharkov.ua}}</ref> Klepikov died on 1 March 2026, at the age of 76.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=With deep sorrow, we announce that on March 1, 2026, at the age of 77, the heart of the outstanding Ukrainian theoretical physicist, science organizer, and corresponding member of the NAS of Ukraine Vyacheslav Fedorovych Klepikov stopped beating. |url=https://www.nas.gov.ua/en/news/z-glibokim-sumom-spovishchayemo-shcho-01-bereznya-2026-roku-na-77-roci-zhittya-zupinilos-serce-vidatnogo-ukranskogo-fizika-teoretika-organizatora-nauki-chlena-korespondenta-nan-ukrani--vyacheslava-fedorovicha-klepikova |access-date=2026-03-03 |website=NAS |language=uk}}</ref>
